caveats: sessions are synthetic and generated on the same machine that grades them; a real mirror port also has to write the capture to disk, so this measures the analysis pipeline, not the switch or the disk
method: one process, single thread; the pipeline figure reads every capture back from disk, reassembles both directions and grades it (generation of the synthetic corpus is timed separately and excluded); the analysis figure grades pre-parsed sessions, median of 3 passes, so it is comparable with the 448-session headline rate
